description: Is this lot still within shelf life on a given date? (unopened and after-opening limits, minimum remaining days) — For up to 100 lots, computes the expiry date from manufacture/fill date + shelf life (days, weeks, months, years; month arithmetic clamps to month end) and from opened date + after-opening life, takes the earlier, and checks it against a caller asOf date and an optional minimum remaining days at receipt; flags a labelled expiry that disagrees with the computed one. The last day of life is the expi
name: shelf-life-check
